children: US equipment rental provider's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 11%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS and adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q1 beat analyst expectations
Company raised full-year fiscal 2027 guidance following strong Q1 performance
Sunbelt Rentals raises full-year 2027 total revenue growth outlook to 6%-9%
Company now sees full-year rental revenue growth of 7%-10%
Company expects adjusted EBITDA for fiscal 2027 between $4.92 bln and $5.12 bln
SPECIALTY SEGMENT GROWTH - North America Specialty segment rental revenue rose 25%, supported by strong demand and the acquisition of Reliant Asset Management (Aries brand)
EVENT-DRIVEN DEMAND - FIFA World Cup contributed about 250 basis points to rental revenue growth, highlighting demand for complex event rentals
BROAD END-MARKET DEMAND - Growth was geographically broad and spanned diverse end markets, including mega projects, energy, live events, industrial, and non-construction MRO
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Sunbelt Rentals Holdings Inc is $86.50, about 24.8% above its September 8 closing price of $69.32
The stock recently traded at 16 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 18 three months ago
